cs.t: I have a DECT headset and I would never go back to Bluetooth. The range, reliability and the quality of modern DECT is great. Just make sure you get one with ultra wide band or similar otherwise you end up with cordless phone quality.
cs.th: Wi-Fi 8 is the first wireless upgrade in years that isn't chasing speed

cs.t: I use a DECT VoIP phone for most of my phone calls. It's great!
cs.th: Does our “need for speed” make our wi-fi suck?
